//REGION '!' over her: queue once, the vanilla relationship dialog system shows it

// she is with us: in the active party, or in camp as a companion (then the mark shows in camp)
QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_WithUs()
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_WithUs()
AND
NOT DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

// she was near the event: a speaker of that dialog, or in the party within 15 m of its hero
QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_Near((INTEGER)_Inst)
AND
DB_DialogSpeakers(_Inst, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_Near((INTEGER)_Inst)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
DB_DialogPlayers(_Inst, _Player, _)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Player, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 15.0
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_NearObject((GUIDSTRING)_Object)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Object, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 15.0
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Event((STRING)_Key)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Talk_WithUs()
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Queue(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Local((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Queue(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Queue((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_Dead(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_TalkQueued(_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _, _)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_TalkQueued(_Key);
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Start(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Start((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _Dialog, _)
THEN
PROC_RelationshipDialog((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Dialog, (FLAG)NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 0, -100);

// 'Not now': the game has marked it finished - put the mark up again, same talk
IF
DB_RelationshipDialogsFinished((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Dialog, _Flag)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _Dialog, _)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Talk_Postponed_ea70a413-216d-5f6d-8384-af55f8191c6d, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 1)
THEN
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Talk_Postponed_ea70a413-216d-5f6d-8384-af55f8191c6d, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 0);
NOT DB_RelationshipDialogsFinished(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Dialog, _Flag);
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Start(_Key);

//END_REGION

//REGION S2a: below 20 approval she leaves with the refugees (ALFSV_LeftWithRefugees, she returns in act 2)

IF
DialogEnded((DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_WRD_Event_RoadExpelled_198867ca-3ab9-4f1a-b81d-994fa27a6087, _)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_LeftWithRefugees_08896048-db4d-5611-9d0c-93f4da139f4e)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_LeaveWithRefugees();

// Out of the party like a companion leaving (the approval and the in-party dialog stay for act 2), and she walks
// away after the refugees. DB_ALFSV_Left blocks recruitment in act 1 (ALFSV_Companion.txt).
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_LeaveWithRefugees()
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1);
DB_ALFSV_Left("Refugees");
PROC_ALFSV_Talks_ClearOMs();
PROC_Origins_CompanionLeaveTemporarily((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_LeftWithRefugees");
PROC_DisappearOutOfSight(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "Walk", 1, "ALFSV_Talk_LeftWithRefugees");

//REGION S2b: after the farewell she leaves for good, goes to the Grove and dies in the raid, as without recruitment

// the farewell said (flag on its last line)

THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_GoToGrove();

AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_CancelRelationshipDialog((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_WRD_Event_GatesOpened_101ef669-22d4-4503-9d62-ee778f46ae19, (FLAG)NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000);
NOT DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1);
DB_ALFSV_Left("GatesOpened");
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_LeftForGrove_ed11c78c-296c-5cdb-91ff-1f8ca186a3ac);
PROC_ALFSV_Talks_ClearOMs();
PROC_Origins_CompanionLeavePermanently((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_GatesOpened");
PROC_DisappearOutOfSight(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "Run", 1, "ALFSV_Talk_GoneToGrove");
ObjectTimerLaunch(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_Talk_ToGrove", 20000);

IF
EntityEvent(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_Talk_GoneToGrove")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_DieInGrove();

IF
ObjectTimerFinished(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_Talk_ToGrove")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_DieInGrove();

// In the children's hideout, where the raid finds her in the game (DB_DEN_NPC role "Hideout", Act1_DEN_Misc.txt:197)

PROC_ALFSV_Talk_DieInGrove()
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_Talk_InHideout(1)
AND
NOT DB_Dead(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_Talk_InHideout(1);
ObjectTimerCancel(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, "ALFSV_Talk_ToGrove");
SetOnStage(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 1);
SetFaction(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, (FACTION)ACT1_DEN_AttackOnDen_Defenseless_0d52984d-82c0-44b3-861c-5f8107982525);
TeleportTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, S_DEN_AttackKidPos_011_653cf07f-e6ac-46eb-bb02-041ed278498e, "");
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_HideoutFate();

// The hideout massacre has not happened yet: the game kills her itself (PROC_DEN_AttackOnDen_KillKids: Die(S_DEN_Bard),
// Act1_DEN_AttackOnDen.txt:3128-3133). Already happened, or the raid is over: now, the way KillKids does it.

DB_OnlyOnce("DEN_AttackOnDen_KidsDieOrRun")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_DieNow();

THEN

AND

THEN

NOT DB_Dead(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN

//REGION Debug (Script Extender console)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Talk("GroveHeld") - put the '!' up again (ignores 'once'; she must be a companion)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkNow("Kagha") - start the talk right now with the host (no mark)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkMirkon() - S4 starts with Mirkon (otherwise Arabella)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OM("Asharak") - the scene before the NPC dialog is offered again (then talk to him)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OMNow("Dammon") - the three-way scene right now (the NPC must be near)
// Keys: GroveHeld, RoadExpelled, GatesOpened, Kagha, Children, Karlach, Tadpole, Blood, ZevlorMap, Gnolls, Tollhouse, Campsite, Volo, Dammon; OM: Asharak, Lakrissa, Dammon

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Talk((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _Dialog, _)
AND
DB_RelationshipDialogsFinished((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Dialog, _Flag)
THEN
NOT DB_RelationshipDialogsFinished(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Dialog, _Flag);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Talk((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_TalkQueued(_Key)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_TalkQueued(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Talk((STRING)_Key)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Talk_Queue(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkNow((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _Dialog, "event")
AND
GetHostCharacter(_Host)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Host)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkNow((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Talk(_Key, _Dialog, "local")
AND
_Key != "Dammon"
AND
GetHostCharacter(_Host)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Host)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkMirkon()
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Talk_Children_Mirkon_c4f66ee3-e6cd-55d9-aaf1-50e0125e83d3, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 0);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OM("Asharak")
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_OM("Asharak");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMPlayed("Asharak");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMDefined("Asharak");
PROC_ALFSV_Talks_DefineOMs();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OMNow("Asharak")
AND
GetHostCharacter(_Host)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed((DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_OM_Local_Asharak_154c85d2-9e41-4ab0-9c48-67a47cd4044a, S_DEN_Trainer_02025646-347a-4235-aef7-e46b7c94b435, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Host)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OM("Lakrissa")
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_OM("Lakrissa");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMPlayed("Lakrissa");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMDefined("Lakrissa");
PROC_ALFSV_Talks_DefineOMs();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OMNow("Lakrissa")
AND
GetHostCharacter(_Host)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed((DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_OM_Local_Lakrissa_5858cd09-6f15-4c79-8092-f058a464ac10, S_DEN_Tiefling_010_23129d6c-8d39-4a4c-a4f6-cfc6637b597c, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Host)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OM("Dammon")
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_OM("Dammon");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMPlayed("Dammon");
NOT DB_ALFSV_OMDefined("Dammon");
PROC_ALFSV_Talks_DefineOMs();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OMNow("Dammon")
AND
GetHostCharacter(_Host)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed((DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_OM_Local_Dammon_f5c9b87d-667d-4938-9309-9a12c77f9c91, S_DEN_Weaponsmith_e2ad06ec-8034-479a-9f69-b86faea6dc79, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Host)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_TalkNow("Dammon")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_OMNow("Dammon");
